definitions.gloss: in order; in turn; one by one
definitions.explanation: Following a proper sequence; each taking their turn without skipping.

examples.japanese: {順々|じゅんじゅん}に{並|なら}んでください。
{順々|じゅんじゅん}に{名前|なまえ}を{呼|よ}びます。
examples.english: I will call names in order.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}を{順々|じゅんじゅん}に{解|と}いていく。
examples.english: To solve problems one by one in order.

notes:
USAGE: Emphasizes following proper order or sequence. Similar to {順番|じゅんばん}に but with more emphasis on the one-by-one aspect.

PATTERN: {順々|じゅんじゅん}に + verb

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{順番|じゅんばん}に (in order, by turns)
・{次々|つぎつぎ}に (one after another - less emphasis on order)
・{一|ひと}つずつ (one by one)

NOTE: The repetition (ABAB pattern) emphasizes the systematic nature of the sequence.
